    Products outside the insertion span (BGRS 1.7 a) #

    If inserting e_y + t ρ between f and h keeps f h in its ray for every scalar t and every radical ρ of R_y, then f ρ h lies in the radical R(f h) of the subbimodule generated by f h; hence the insertion span M(f, h) lies in R(f h) and does not contain f h (RayQuiver.mul_not_mem_insertionSpan).

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayQuiver.unit_mul_mem_endpointRadical {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {A : Type v} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] (F : PrimitiveIdempotents A) {x z : Fin F.m} {p : A} (hp : p ∈ F.corner x z) {u w : A} (hu : F.IsCornerUnit x u) (hw : F.IsCornerUnit z w) :
    ∃ (c : k), c ≠ 0 ∧ u * p * w - c • p ∈ F.endpointRadical x z p

    u p w ≡ λ κ p modulo R(p) for corner units u = λ e + u', w = κ e + w'.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayQuiver.mul_not_mem_insertionSpan {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {A : Type v} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] (F : PrimitiveIdempotents A) {x y z : Fin F.m} {f h : A} (hf : f ∈ F.corner x y) (hh : h ∈ F.corner y z) (hfh : f * h ≠ 0) (hray : ∀ (t : k), ∀ ρ ∈ F.cornerRadical y, ∃ (u : A) (w : A), F.IsCornerUnit x u ∧ F.IsCornerUnit z w ∧ f * (F.e y + t • ρ) * h = u * (f * h) * w) :
    f * h ∉ F.insertionSpan x y z f h

    BGRS 1.7 a).
